subject.title: Redesign publish plugin & skill empty states

question: Should ClawHub accept upload-first publish empty states as the preferred UX for new skill and plugin publishing?
rationale: The diff is a UI/product direction change rather than a narrow bug fix, and current evidence does not show maintainer approval of replacing the visible disabled-form preview with hidden metadata until upload.

options.title: Accept Upload-First After Proof
options.body: Adopt this direction once the contributor adds real running ClawHub proof for both empty and post-upload flows.

options.title: Keep Disabled-Form Preview
options.body: Ask the contributor to retain the current visible form preview and only improve copy or disabled-state clarity.

options.title: Narrow To Plugin Publish
options.body: Apply upload-first only to plugins if maintainers want skill publishing to keep its current editable-first workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept Upload-First After Proof
recommendation.body: Adopt this direction once the contributor adds real running ClawHub proof for both empty and post-upload flows.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-history connection to the publish route and prepublication flow being redesigned.
